pages.title: Shuriken
pages.text: Strike your enemies from afar with this sharp throwing star. Right click to hurl a spinning Shuriken in the direction you are looking. A Shuriken can be used 32 times before it breaks, and in close combat it still hits for 3.2 attack damage.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: Four iron ingots in the corners around a piece of Loran in the centre.
